verses.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੋ ਉਦੋਤ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਮੈ ਤਾ ਮੈ ਤਿਲ ਛਬਿ ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਛਕਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dharasan jot ko udhot asacharaj mai taa mai til chhab paramadhabhut chhak hai ||

en.bdb: The divine radiance of True Guru's light is astonishing. Even a miniscule part of that light is beautiful, marvellous and quaint.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਬੋ ਕੌ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਸੁਨਬੇ ਕੌ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਹੈ ਕਹਿਬੇ ਕੌ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਨ ਗਯਾਨ ਮੈ ਉਕਤਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dhekhabo kau dhirasaT na sunabe kau surat hai kahibe kau jihavaa na gayaan mai ukat hai ||

en.bdb: Eyes have no power to see, ears have no power to hear and tongue has no power to describe the beauty of that light divine. Nor are there words in the world to describe it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਭਾ ਕੋਟਿ ਸੋਭ ਲੋਭ ਲੁਭਤ ਹੁਇ ਲੋਟ ਪੋਟ ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਓਟ ਲੈ ਛਿਪਤਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sobhaa koT sobh lobh lubhat hui loT poT jagamag jot koT oT lai chhipat hai ||

en.bdb: Numerous praises, lights of glittering lamp hide behind curtains before this supernatural light.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਪੇਖ ਮਨ ਮਨਸਾ ਥਕਤ ਭਈ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਅਤਿ ਹੂ ਤੇ ਅਤਿ ਹੈ ॥੧੪੦॥
verses.translit_en: a(n)g a(n)g pekh man manasaa thakat bhiee net net namo namo at hoo te at hai ||140||

en.bdb: A very momentary glimpse of that divine effulgence ends all the notions and options of the mind. The praise of such glimpse is infinite, most wondrous and marvellous. Thus He should be saluted again and again. (140)
